entity: FOR_joint history = Quality Alpha joint proxy
definition_plain_english: FOR_joint = Fund alpha proxy: stays on floor closer (high quality) — composite of profitability, moat, cash conversion, balance health, valuation discipline, growth. Ring = alpha vs benchmark. FOR_joint high = cheap-for-quality closer.

operationalization.cheap_for_quality_surplus_formula: surplus = Profitability% - (100 - Valuation_Discipline%) = Prof*100 - (100 - Val*100). Positive = cheap for how good it is (value not trap)
operationalization.piotroski_proxy_formula: 0-9 proxy: +1 each: ROA>0 (Prof>0.5), CFO>0 (Cash>0.4), dROA>0 (Growth>0.5), CFO>ROA (Cash>Prof), Lev↓ (Bal>0.6), Liquid↑ (Cash>0.5), NoDilution (Yield>0.3), GM↑ (Moat>0.5), Turn↑ (Eff>0.5)
operationalization.altman_z_proxy: Balance_Health skill directly (0-1) — distress tolerance inverse
operationalization.source: assets/real_data.json points 2015-2024, filtered 2020-2024, 500 tickers max, 154 feats 20 towers 64-d transformer
operationalization.no_fabrication: All numbers computed deterministic from real_data.json skills; no synthetic FYs introduced
